amanda_csm: Hey team - Elysian Health is going live with an APAC pilot tomorrow. Can we do a temporary QPS bump + CIDR allowlist for their proxy egress? Need low-latency routing to sg region and a 24h grace window.

maria_ops: Got it. What's the requested QPS and the source CIDRs? Also any special header/tls hints?

amanda_csm: Requested QPS = 1,200 for the 24h window. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.128/25. They use mTLS client certs to our proxy, no extra headers. Renewal at noon UTC.

kai_infra: pinging infra - which region to pin? apac-sg preferred. Also confirm fallback if sg capacity throttles.

zane_se: For traffic profile, are these short chats (low tokens) or embedding-heavy? affects batching and cost.

amanda_csm: Mostly short chat completions ~50 tokens avg, occasional long docs (up to 1k tokens) but rare. Cost not a blocker for pilot, priority is latency.

kai_infra: Ok. I'll open an infra request. We need a Jira and a support ticket. tagging @devops-bot to provision temporary allowlist + qps window.

devops-bot: New request logged: RQ-4276. Props: customer=elysian, env=prod-pilot, region=apac-sg, qps=1200, cidrs=[203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.128/25], ttl=24h. ETA for change: ~45m.

maria_ops: Can you paste the config snippet I'll send to their network team?

zane_se: Here's a minimal snippet you can share:
```
customer: elysian
region: apac-sg
qps_limit: 1200
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.128/25
egress_ttl: 24h
notes: mTLS client certs expected, no extra headers
```

maria_ops: Perfect. I'll send and loop in legal for the temporary exception. Also capturing feedback: ask them to report any latency diffs vs us-east baseline.

amanda_csm: Sent to Elysian ops and legal. They replied: "confirming CIDRs and window, we'll run smoke tests at 0200 UTC." :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Change applied to edge-routes in apac-sg, RQ-4276 -> DONE. QPS cap set to 1200, CIDRs added, auto-revoke scheduled after 24h.

kai_infra: Verified routing and KVcache warmup started. Monitoring alert set if p50 > 120ms or error rate > 0.5%.

amanda_csm: Thanks everyone. I'll update the renewal tracker — note: pilot performance will inform their renewal conversation next month. Capture any regressions and I'll attach to the account health doc. :sparkles:
